notes.title: PATCH 0.88 : Graphics option and balancing
notes.content:
[h3]BALANCING[/h3]
- The duration of the tank opening time has increased from 2 sec to 3.5 sec. 
Thus making the bombs more effective, but also the levels slightly more difficult.

[h3]INTERFACE[/h3]
- Graphics option taken into account for the backup system
- Added the application run background
- Added vsync 
- Added resolution choice. 
- If played with the steamdeck the game will automatically choose the steamdeck resolution without overwriting the saved resolution.

notes.title: #3 Flesh Psychosis - Steam Cooking Fest - Demo 💖🍲
notes.content:
[h2]Flesh Psychosis Joins the Steam Cooking Fest ![/h2]

We’re excited to announce that Flesh Psychosis is part of the Steam Cooking Fest 🎉 The event runs for a full week, so dive into the demo, give it a try, and let us know what you think! Don’t forget to add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] to stay updated on future releases—it really helps us out.
We hope you enjoy this little game!

[h3]Demo updates and improvements :[/h3]
- Minor bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.
- Balance adjustments on recipes during crafting and cooking phases.
- Levels 3 and 4 enhanced: added "Eyes" ingredients for more variety !
- New special ability: Ingredient Transformation – for 5 bones, swap one ingredient for the next, giving you more strategic culinary options !

notes.title: #2 Flesh Psychosis - Steam Scream Demo 💖🧩
notes.content:
🎃 Flesh Psychosis is live for the Steam Scream Festival ! 🎃
Hey everyone ! We’re excited to announce that Flesh Psychosis is officially part of the Steam Scream Halloween Festival ! You can now dive into our game with a public BETA demo ! 🧪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098385/e8ebe2ee6666b30ef409e30291a6b1f5b5b50031.jpg[/img]

🔍 We need your feedback !
Since this is a beta version, everything is subject to change! Feel free to share your impressions, ideas, or suggestions—any feedback is valuable to help us improve.

❤️ Demo Updates :
Here are some new features and adjustments added to this version:
- 20 actions instead of 10 before each cooking phase, giving you more time to explore and enjoy.
- Rebalanced components in the cooking recipes.
- Minor interface changes for better clarity.
- New level added—now 4 levels are available in this demo!
- UX/UI improvements for a smoother experience.

We’re thrilled to finally share this first playable version with you. 🎉 Hope you enjoy exploring the world of Flesh Psychosis ! 👻

Thanks in advance for your support and feedback, 💖
